questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Approach দুদিকে: f′=f(v+vo)/(v−vs)=32×(11)·350/320=35×(11)। numerator ও denominator signs ভিন্ন।

questions.question_bn: 10 mol ideal diatomic gas, vibrational modes frozen। U/(RT) কত?

questions.question_bn: CathodereductionE°=14/10 V,anodereductionE°=−0.20 V। E°cell কত V?

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=15×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((15)×10⁻²)=(1/(15))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 10%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Convertedmass 1000·(10)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=20 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=20L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(20)−0.04×(20)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: 2SO₂+O₂→2SO₃। SO₂amount 19molfullyconvert। oxygen needed কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। CoefficientratioO₂:SO₂=1:2। needn/2molO₂; oxygen atom count molecular count distinct ion।

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=8। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Shell includes l=0…(8)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(8)²। electron capacity 2×(8)², orbitals নয়।

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 250g,dry mass 200g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(25)/(10×(25))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 21mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Ozone decomposition 2O₃→3O₂। 6 mol ozone fully decomposes। total gas mole increase কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। FinalO₂=(3/2)(6)। initial gas (6), increase=(3/2)(6)−(6)=(6)/2; final mole ও increment আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Acidic Cr₂O₇²⁻ 7mmol→2Cr³⁺। total electron accepted কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: A⇌B-এর K=16। 2B⇌2A-এর equilibrium constant কত?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C5H10 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
